title: curlysim v1: live-conditions 3D POV surf sim at North Curl Curl
description: Static Three.js+Vite site for GitHub Pages /curlysim. Open-Meteo marine+forecast (verified CORS/keyless) drive Gerstner wave field (primary swell split into detuned components for real set/lull timing), wind chop, shoaling+foam surf zone, sky/sun via suncalc, low-poly procedural terrain (N+S headlands, lagoon, SLSC clubhouses, Long Reef horizon), crowd sim from conditions+time. POV: sitting on board at North Curly A-frame, click-drag look, NO HUD (debug gui behind ?debug). Real-time sim: wait for sets.
notes: PIVOT: rewrote wave physics from spectral Gerstner sum to discrete wave-train model (user request: 'serious rewrite'). Each wave = object with position/height advancing at c=sqrt(gd); shape from local depth (Green shoaling, front-face steepening, 0.78d breaking -> bore + foam); peel emerges from bank depth field; explicit set/lull group generator (3 set waves per ~11). Chop system disabled pending its own pass. Night removed (permanent daytime). Camera: fixed horizontal, rides surface +0.85m, WoW drag.

title: First-person body: legs + surfboard visible when looking down (scale reference)
description: Add the viewer's own legs and a true-scale surfboard to the POV rig so wave size reads against a body. Sitting astride the board (eye 0.85 m). Board ~6'4" x 0.5 m x 6 cm, legs ~0.9 m hip-to-sole.
